data.body:
Implemented in local commit 1ae781b63ab (worktree fix-prompt-eval-live), shared with knightly-salty-orangutan and newborn-advanced-hoopoe: one change, because all three are needed before the eval-live loop scores anything and they touch disjoint files in the same subsystem (eval.py+workflow / eval_solver.py / eval_scorers.py).

- `eval.py`: new `_gated(solve, repo_root=...)` resolves `resolve_gate_handle(None, SOURCE_LOCAL, repo_root, fetch=False)` once and runs every case inside `gate_read_root(handle)`; applied in `run_eval` and `calibrate_criterion`. `run_eval` now returns `errored` and `run_failure`.
- `prompt-eval.yml`: specs with `run_failure` go to `::error::` and the step exits 1 after all JUnit files are written; scored regressions stay `::warning::`.
- Offline evidence: the 3 new tests in `tests/unit/test_eval.py` pass on the change and all 3 fail when run against origin/main 05c6414358f code (PYTHONPATH pointed at a detached origin/main worktree).
- No live LLM run: the offline tests reach `assert_gated` itself, which is the failing call, so a paid run adds nothing.
- Portability: a contextvars marker plus `Path.resolve()` of the checkout; no subprocess, fd, signal or POSIX-only path API.

Next: make verify, then Gerrit.
